name: dragapult_ml_v2
policy: Typed-route imitation. The teacher-conditioned ranker owns every routed, mandatory, single-pick decision; the deterministic policy owns multi-pick, optional declines, unseen candidates and unrouted contexts. The only override is mechanical: a duplicate-colour route attachment is replaced when the same decision offers one that completes the Fire+Psychic pair.
changes_from_v1: typed Energy per body, route ETA before/after a candidate, and completes-the-pair columns: v1 could not distinguish Fire onto a Psychic-holding Dragapult from Fire onto a Fire-holding one
resolved card tables (prize value, weakness, printed HP, attack-cost frontier) so damage, knock-outs and spread value are computable
ABILITY options resolved from area/index instead of the absent inPlayArea/inPlayIndex, in both the features and the rule policy
remainingOverageTime removed: teachers 572-592s vs our 591-599s made every learned split out of distribution
Phantom Dive spread features and rule scoring read the remaining counter budget instead of assuming all six
Ultra Ball's two-card discard ordered by the teachers' measured discard rate (training split only) instead of a hand-written priority
corpus refreshed from 854 trajectories / 9 teachers to 1392 / 15
the broad v1.1 deterministic override removed: it seized 2322 test decisions at 0.4018 agreement against the model's 0.7273

controlled_feature_ablation.note: identical 854 episodes, identical splits, patience 800 on both arms

runtime_test.index: data/kaggle_dragapult_exact, chronological test split of train_full.json
